Entry Lion of Night The night lion is a dark force or king of the night in Far Eastern mythology, often juxtaposed with the opposition of long night, plunder and light. It should not necessarily be understood as an identifiable entity; for the narrator, the Night Lion first gives the boundless darkness a card to hate and resist.
